# Final activation runbook - 50 playable / 50 locked games and 2 client staff accounts

**Rule:** the activation release has the restrictions COMPILED IN. Deploying it IS the activation. It is therefore built and staged, and deployed only after the owner has the client's written acknowledgment (see CLIENT_ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DRAFT.md). A verbal agreement reported by the owner is not enough on its own.

## Configuration (from PROPOSED_GAME_ALLOCATION.json, generated by `scripts/qa/apply-activation-policy.mjs`)
* 50 playable, 50 locked, Wild Panther playable, Color Game Pro locked; the compiled list equals the file (unit-tested).
* Staff cap 2 (any role except player). Players, the owner superadmin and QA accounts are not counted.
* No grant keys: unlocking a game or raising the cap requires a new verified release.
* Notices: "Game Locked. Please settle the remaining project payment to activate this game." / "Account Limit Reached. Please settle the remaining project payment to add more client accounts."
* Accounts: `client_admin01`, `client_admin02`, role administrator, 0 synthetic credits, random temporary passwords written to a local file only.

## Order of events
1. (done by the assistant) Build + CI + artifact verification + kit pins + test evidence.
2. (owner) Send the acknowledgment; store the client's written reply. Tell the assistant "acknowledgment received".
3. (owner, sudo) fresh trigger-aware backup (R2 pattern), extract + plan, apply/switch script. Same three runs as the previous deployment; the switch script rolls the application back automatically if health fails.
4. (assistant) `node scripts/qa/verify-activation.mjs` : 50 locked refuse, 50 playable play, admin catalog Locked, activation refused, notices.
5. (owner, sudo, one command) set the database-layer cap: `activate-restrictions.mjs --max-clients 2 --enforce yes` through the reviewed path (dry run first). Until this runs the compiled application layer already enforces the cap; the database triggers are the second layer.
6. (assistant) `node scripts/qa/create-client-staff.mjs --apply`, then `node scripts/qa/verify-activation.mjs --staff-created` (third staff account rejected), ledger reconciliation, 100-game-equivalent checks (50/50), browser checks.
7. (owner) fill the 7-day dates in CLIENT_TESTING_HANDOVER.md, deliver the URL and each login through separate channels, remind the client of the PHP 50,000 balance.

## Rollback
Reinstall `uat-run.rollback-<previous sha>.mjs` and restart `maxhigh-uat` (all earlier releases stay on the VPS). Database changes are additive; never restore over UAT, restore into the isolated check schema and compare.
